details.value: Yes; start-ups are accepted, with 700+ FICO and additional 10% security deposit noted.
Expected submission-to-decision turnaround time is 1 business day.
May need 4 months’ bank statements and/or Personal Financial Statement for each personal guarantor.
Not required for applicants with 2 years or more in business unless credit history is limited or has issues. For start-ups, prior year personal taxes will likely be required.
Broker points/markups are built into the funding amount.
Underwriting call is made on every application prior to final approval.

uncertainties.reason: Document is expressly for 'Non-Trucking Applications'; this was modeled as a hard lender-level is_trucking is_false restriction, but the lender may have separate trucking programs not covered by this PDF.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether this profile should decline all trucking or only route trucking deals to another Advantage+ program.

uncertainties.reason: The catalog has no ABCD credit-tier field. The minimum FICO rules capture the explicit numeric credit requirements only.
uncertainties.suggestion: If ABCD grades are used by the underwriting engine, add a credit_grade field or map grades externally.

uncertainties.reason: 'Do you finance bankruptcies? No' was modeled as no bankruptcies at all using has_bankruptcy is_false; the document does not specify whether very old discharged bankruptcies are ever acceptable.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether any historical bankruptcy is a decline or only open/recent bankruptcies.

uncertainties.reason: The document says 'No collections or charge-offs in the past 3 years.' The catalog has has_recent_collections but no charge-off field and no field to measure years since collection/charge-off.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm the engine definition of has_recent_collections and consider adding charge_off and recency fields.

uncertainties.reason: There is no security_deposit_pct field, so the start-up security deposit requirement was placed in program details rather than encoded as a rule.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add security_deposit_pct if this requirement must be evaluated automatically.

uncertainties.reason: The document prefers secondary income sources such as working spouse/PG or pension, but the catalog has no field for secondary income source.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add a secondary_income_available or household/PG income field if this should be scored.

uncertainties.item: Tax return and financial statement requirements
uncertainties.reason: Financials, bank statements, tax returns, PFS requirements and conditions are documentation requirements, not credit-decline rules in the catalog.
uncertainties.suggestion: Handle required documents through a documentation workflow rather than credit rules.

uncertainties.reason: The document bans charge-offs in the past 3 years, but the catalog does not include a has_charge_offs or years_since_charge_off field.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add charge-off fields if automated enforcement is required.
